title: Japanese Tofu Skewers with Floral Crisp Salad
description: A refreshing Asian-inspired salad and protein-packed tofu skewers make for a delicious and healthy meal.
instructions: 1. Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and thread onto skewers.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger.
3. Brush the tofu skewers with the soy-ginger mixture.
5. Grill the tofu skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
6. Meanwhile, combine the mixed greens, chopped carrots, and a drizzle of soy-ginger mixture in a large bowl.
7. To assemble the salad, place a scoop of the floral crisp mixture on a plate, followed by a few grilled tofu skewers.
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Garnish with additional mixed greens and sesame seeds if desired.
